CustomField.description: On 1/17/20, increased from 10 to 11 SOE competencies, with the addition of 'Resume SOE Date'.
CustomField.formula:
(if (Send_Out_Eligible_by_Previous_Criteria__c, 1,
(IF((ISBLANK( Housing_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Child_Care_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Health_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Background_Check_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Time_Management_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Conflict_Management_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Professionalism_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Team_Building_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Communication_SOE_Date__c )) , 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Drug_Test_Submitted_Date__c)), 0, 1) + IF((ISBLANK( Resume_SOE_Date__c )), 0, 1) )/11))
CustomField.label: Percent to Send Out Eligible
